lessons_used: Waiting screen enhancements (wait_info) are helpful and consistently yield statistically significant gains.
Adding a pet preview screen before the adoption certificate (new_screen) is helpful and produced a large significant gain (+15.4%).
Copy adjustments (copy), layout changes (layout), sign-in reordering (reorder), tutorials (redesign), and progress hints (hint) showed no clear effect.
Predictions underestimated large wins, such as the pet preview screen (+3.0% predicted vs +15.4% measured).
Predictions were generally too high for changes that showed no clear effect.

lessons_next: Waiting screen enhancements (wait_info) can be helpful, producing significant gains in two tests (+5.0% and +5.7%), though one test showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens (new_screen) had mixed results: the pet preview screen won with a large gain (+15.4%), but the quiz screen significantly hurt performance (-7.7%).
Copy adjustments (copy), layout changes (layout), sign-in reordering (reorder), tutorials (redesign), and hints (hint) showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins, such as the pet preview screen (+3.0% predicted vs +15.4% measured).
Predictions were generally too high for changes that showed no clear effect or resulted in a loss (e.g., predicting +15.4% for the quiz screen which measured -7.7%).
